package.json.description: Monorepo with 3 workspaces: shared (types-only), control-server (Fastify backend), docs-site (React frontend). Uses npm workspaces.

shared/package.json.description: Shared workspace exports raw TypeScript (.ts) files directly via main/exports fields. No build step - relies on consumers having TypeScript support.

control-server/package.json.description: TypeScript version ^5.3.3 in control-server vs ^5.2.2 in docs-site - minor version mismatch that could cause subtle behavioral differences

docs-site/package.json.description: The lint script uses deprecated ESLint CLI flags (--ext ts,tsx) that are incompatible with flat config format used in eslint.config.js. The --ext flag is ignored in flat config mode.

docs-site/src/components/VoiceCompanion..description: Contains 25+ console.log/warn/error statements. Most are debug logs prefixed with [VoiceCompanion]. Consider using a proper logging utility or removing debug logs in production.

control-server/test/.description: Control-server has 5 test files with ~33 test cases. Test coverage gaps: no tests for /api/containers, /api/logs, or most /api/settings/* endpoints.

docs-site/tests/smoke.spec.ts.description: Smoke tests have 10 test cases covering: deep links, homepage loading, navigation, wizard accessibility, AI assistant button, JS errors, config generation/download, storage planner with Tdarr paths, and AI assistant chat. Tests directory is NOT included in tsconfig.json - relies on Playwright's own TS handling.

docs-site/playwright.config.ts.description: Playwright config starts two webServers: 1) control-server (builds first, then runs on port 3001), 2) Vite dev server on port 5175. Uses 120s timeout for server startup. The 'AI assistant can chat with control-server' test requires both servers running.

scripts/check_app_docs.py.description: Python script that validates Docker Compose services have corresponding documentation in docs/app.md. Called by npm run check with --strict flag. Uses fuzzy matching to link services to documentation sections.

control-server/src/app.ts.description: Root endpoint (/) returns JSON with service info: service name, status, version, and available endpoints array

control-server/src/routes/docker.ts.description: /api/containers endpoint works correctly - returns HTTP 200 with JSON array of Container objects (id, name, status, state, ports). Has caching with DOCKER_STATUS_CACHE_MS env var (default 1500ms). Has in-flight request deduplication to prevent parallel docker ps calls. Returns 503 with docker_unavailable error when Docker daemon not running.

control-server/src/routes/ai.ts.description: Settings endpoints are defined in ai.ts (lines 784-890): GET/POST/DELETE /api/settings/openai-key, GET /api/settings/openai-key/status, GET /api/settings/stt, GET /api/settings/tts, GET /api/settings/tts/status. All 7 endpoints respond correctly with HTTP 200. Test coverage gap: voice.test.ts only covers /api/settings/stt and /api/settings/tts - missing tests for /api/settings/openai-key endpoints.

docs-site/src/main.tsx.description: /settings route is correctly configured with lazy loading (lines 119-135). SettingsPage component loaded via React.lazy() with proper Suspense fallback showing loading spinner. Route matches smoke test expectations (main element visible).

docs-site/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx.description: SettingsPage has all required test IDs for cockpit test: cockpit-restart (line 518), cockpit-recheck (line 528), 'Last checked:' label (line 511). Renders <main> as root element (line 456) matching smoke test assertion. StatusBadge component includes status-badge testId.

docs-site/src/components/SetupWizard.tsx.description: Wizard has 6 steps (0-5): Welcome, Basic Config, Stack Selection, Service Config, Advanced, Review. Navigation handled by handleNextStep() with validation for steps 1, 2, and 4. Generates 4 files: .env, authelia-configuration.yml, cloudflare-config.yml, docker-compose.yml. Full E2E test coverage in smoke.spec.ts line 107-193.

docs-site/src/components/AIAssistant.tsx.description: AI Assistant component (1021 lines) with floating button, chat panel, streaming responses, voice I/O, agent selection, and proactive nudges. Button at fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 with title="Ask AI Assistant". Uses streaming chat hook with fallback to non-streaming. Comprehensive E2E test coverage in smoke.spec.ts.
